newsitem.title: CANADA: Quebec sets C$500 mln in 10- and 30-year bonds.
newsitem.headline: Quebec sets C$500 mln in 10- and 30-year bonds.

text.p: The Province of Quebec on Thursday set C$150 million in 10-year bonds and C$350 million in 30-year bonds in financial markets, said one dealer involved in the underwriting.
The C$150 million 6.5 percent bond due October 1, 2007 was priced at C$97.036 to yield 6.904 percent, 39 basis points over the Government of Canada's 7.25 percent bond due June, 2007.
The C$350 million 8.5 percent bond due April 1, 2026 was priced at C$112.316 to yield 7.454 percent, 44 basis points over the Government of Canada's 8.0 percent bond due June, 2023.
